context_title:
Convert the attached technical description, file, or Repomix export into one self-contained build prompt. Return only that prompt, never the implementation.



Read the entire input character by character, line by line, beginning to end before writing. Preserve every nonexcluded detail without omissions or abbreviated behavior.



Direct another language model to rebuild the complete system from scratch using only the prompt, without source access or references. Fully specify functionality, behavior, architecture, every necessary file and its required contents, and explicit start-to-finish steps producing complete, production-ready files.



Exclude and prohibit authentication, authorization, access control, security policies, auditing, monitoring, rate/usage/product limits, quotas, billing, payments, tests, documentation, and source/configuration comments. Prohibit placeholders, mocks, dummy implementations, fake services, TODOs, unimplemented methods, and omitted files or functions required by nonexcluded functionality.



Never mention the original software’s name. Replace all name-bearing identifiers with neutral descriptive identifiers, preserving nonexcluded behavior and relationships.
